title: Naturality of inverse coefficient-first bundle projections
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, n natural, A the coefficient quotient at level n+1, and S Noetherian with l invertible. Let r≤s with both prime powers killing A, F a rank d vector bundle and K any ordinary etale derived A-complex. Let D and Dprime be IntegrationTransposeData at r and s as in [def-pur-integration-exponent-transport-data]. Write j:W_s→W_r for integrationVectorTransition.hom and i:J_s→J_r for integrationTensorTransition.hom, with i=identity on the pulled-back K tensor j. Then F_e(i) followed by D.data.pe.hom equals Dprime.data.pe.hom followed by tensor(K,F_e(j)). Likewise F_p(C(i)) followed by D.data.pp.hom equals Dprime.data.pp.hom followed by tensor(C(K),F_p(C(j))). Both pe and pp are the actual inverse coefficient-first projections fixed by ordinary_projection and pro_projection. No trace, coefficient integration, transpose or inverse-purity equation is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Naturality of the ordinary compact-support projection in W gives P_s followed by F_e(i) = tensor(K,F_e(j)) followed by P_r. The two coefficient-first signed symmetries preserve this square by their own naturality. Identify P_r and P_s with the inverses of D.pe and Dprime.pe, then multiply by those isomorphisms on the left and right. This is the first displayed equation. On the pro-etale site apply the same naturality to moduleProjection and use naturality of tensorPullbackComparison to pass to comparedModuleProjection. pro_projection identifies D.pp.inv and Dprime.pp.inv; invert that square in exactly the same way.

theorem integrationCoefficientProjectionNaturality (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (r s : ℕ) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hr : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
    (hs : ((l ^ (s + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
    (d : ℕ) (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S)
    (D : IntegrationTransposeData (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)
      (l ^ (r + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hr S
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hS.pow (r + 1)) d F K
      (vectorIntegration l E n S r hr d F hS) (vectorSite l E n S r hr d F hS))
    (D' : IntegrationTransposeData (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)
      (l ^ (s + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hs S
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hS.pow (s + 1)) d F K
      (vectorIntegration l E n S s hs d F hS) (vectorSite l E n S s hs d F hS))
    :
    (integrationLower (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S d F).map
      (integrationTensorTransition l E n S hS r s hrs hr hs d F K).hom ≫
        D.data.pe.hom = D'.data.pe.hom ≫
      ((Etale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) S).obj K).map
        ((integrationLower (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S d F).map
          (integrationVectorTransition l E n S hS r s hrs hr hs d F).hom) ∧
    (integrationProLower (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S d F).map
      ((comparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) _).map
        (integrationTensorTransition l E n S hS r s hrs hr hs d F K).hom) ≫
      D.data.pp.hom = D'.data.pp.hom ≫
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) S).obj
        ((comparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S).obj K)).map
          ((integrationProLower (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S d F).map
            ((comparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) _).map
              (integrationVectorTransition l E n S hS r s hrs hr hs d F).hom))
